description: Search the publisher network for editorial placements. Filter by price, Domain Authority, Domain Rating, monthly traffic, category, genre, region, turnaround, link type (dofollow or nofollow), whether the outlet is Google-indexed or LLM-ready, a restricted niche it accepts, and availability. Returns a page of matches, highest Domain Authority first by default. Each result carries the same fields as get_placement; a search with niche adds nichePrice, the price of an article in that niche.

available.description: true for placements that can be ordered now, false for unavailable ones.

categories.description: Match any of these categories, e.g. ["Crypto", "Health"].

genres.description: Match any of these genres, what the outlet covers, e.g. ["Tech", "Finance"]. A word matches either side of a compound genre: "Crypto" matches "Crypto & Web3". list_categories lists them.

googleIndexed.description: Only outlets known to be indexed by Google.

linkFollow.description: Only placements with this linkAttributes value: "dofollow" or "nofollow" as the catalog records the link, "unspecified" where it has no record. Nothing records sponsored or ugc, so those match nothing.

llmReady.description: Only outlets flagged as readable by AI crawlers.

minMonthlyTraffic.description: Minimum estimated monthly visits to the outlet's site. Outlets with no traffic figure are left out.

niche.description: Only outlets that accept articles on this restricted subject: CBD, Crypto, Health, Gambling or Erotic. Results then carry nichePrice, and minPrice, maxPrice and the price sorts use it.

query.description: Free text matched against publication name, domain, categories and genres.

region.description: Substring match on the outlet's region.

sort.description: Default da_desc. traffic_desc is most monthly visits first. Missing values sort last.

name: search_placements
title: Search placements
